spec.description: Every Formula 1 race and sprint since 2023, from OpenF1: one lap replayed with every car on the map, positions, gaps, tyres and pace over the race, and two drivers' fastest laps laid over each other, on the track and in speed, throttle and brake.

options.content:
### Formula 1, lap by lap

Every Grand Prix and sprint since 2023, from [OpenF1](https://openf1.org): pick a **season** and a **race** above. The **map** replays one lap with every car on it, about four positions a second, coloured by team: press ▶ on its time bar, or pick another **replay lap**. The charts follow the whole race: positions, gaps to the leader, tyres and pace, with safety car periods shaded.

Pick **driver A** (blue) and **driver B** (orange) above or from the results table: they stand out in the charts below, and the **A against B** tab races their laps from the same start, second by second, with their fastest laps laid over each other.

OpenF1 gives positions on a plane of its own at each circuit; they are placed on the map by fitting a fast lap to the circuit's outline ([bacinger/f1-circuits](https://github.com/bacinger/f1-circuits), MIT), within a few metres. Some races lack positions for part of the race, and 2026 cars report no DRS. Unofficial data, for non-commercial use; not associated with Formula 1. The server keeps each finished session's answers for a month, so OpenF1 is asked once, whoever looks.

spec.rawSql:
-- Both fastest laps on the distance into the lap, and the gap: B's time into the
-- lap at each of A's samples (interpolated between B's), less A's. Above zero A
-- is ahead.
WITH b AS (
  SELECT distance_m AS d, t, lead(distance_m) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS d2, lead(t) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS t2
  FROM $duel WHERE slot = 'B'
),
a AS (SELECT * FROM $duel WHERE slot = 'A'),
delta AS (
  SELECT a.distance_m, b.t + CASE WHEN b.d2 > b.d THEN (b.t2 - b.t) * (a.distance_m - b.d) / (b.d2 - b.d) ELSE 0 END - a.t AS gap
  FROM a ASOF JOIN b ON a.distance_m >= b.d
)
SELECT slot, distance_m, speed_kmh, throttle, brake, gear, NULL::DOUBLE AS gap FROM $duel
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D', distance_m, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, round(gap, 3) FROM delta
ORDER BY slot, distance_m

SELECT x.slot, d.driver, any_value(x.lap) AS lap, any_value(x.lap_s) AS lap_s
FROM $duel x JOIN $drivers d ON d.driver_number = CASE x.slot WHEN 'A' THEN ${driver_a:raw} ELSE ${driver_b:raw} END
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY x.slot

spec.description: The fastest laps of driver A (blue) and driver B (orange) laid over each other on the distance into the lap: speed, throttle and brake (on or off), and at the top the gap between them, positive where A is ahead. Distance is speed integrated over time, scaled so both laps are the same length. Hover anywhere to read all four at that point.
spec.title: Fastest laps, A against B

spec.rawSql:
SELECT lap_number AS "Lap", date AS "Time", coalesce(flag, category) AS "Kind", message AS "Message"
FROM $control
WHERE kind = 'control' AND coalesce(flag, '') NOT IN ('BLUE', 'CLEAR') AND category <> 'Other'
   OR kind = 'control' AND (message ILIKE '%PENALTY%' OR message ILIKE '%INVESTIGATION%')
ORDER BY date

spec.description: Race control's messages: flags, safety cars, investigations and penalties. Blue flags and the all-clears after yellows are left out.
spec.title: Race control

spec.rawSql:
-- Drivers A and B through their own lap of the replay lap number, each from
-- when they started it: two laps side by side, whatever the gap on track.
WITH own AS (
  SELECT driver_number, date_start AS t0, date_end AS t1 FROM $laps
  WHERE lap_number = ${lap:raw} AND driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})
)
SELECT CASE d.driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot,
       round(epoch(r.time - own.t0), 2) AS t, r.speed_kmh, r.throttle,
       CASE WHEN r.brake > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS brake, r.gear
FROM $replay r JOIN $drivers d ON d.driver = r.car JOIN own ON own.driver_number = d.driver_number
WHERE r.time >= own.t0 AND r.time < own.t1
ORDER BY slot, t

-- The ghost map's time bar, in seconds into the lap: both drivers start it at the map's start.
WITH own AS (
  SELECT driver_number, CASE driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot,
         date_start AS t0, date_end AS t1
  FROM $laps WHERE lap_number = ${lap:raw} AND driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})
)
SELECT own.slot, epoch(try_cast(rtrim($brush_to, 'Z') AS TIMESTAMP) - (SELECT min(t0) FROM own)) AS now FROM own

SELECT CASE d.driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot, d.driver, l.lap_duration
FROM $drivers d LEFT JOIN $laps l ON l.driver_number = d.driver_number AND l.lap_number = ${lap:raw}
WHERE d.driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})
ORDER BY slot

spec.description: Speed, throttle, brake (on or off) and gear of driver A (blue) and driver B (orange) on the replay lap, each from the moment they started it, so the two laps line up whatever the gap between them on track. The vertical line and the dots follow the map's time bar: play the map and they move. Hover to read all four bands at one second of the lap.
spec.title: A against B, second by second

spec.rawSql:
-- Drivers A and B on the replay lap, B's clock moved so that both start it at
-- the same instant: the earlier of their two starts.
WITH own AS (
  SELECT driver_number, CASE driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot,
         date_start AS t0, date_end AS t1
  FROM $laps WHERE lap_number = ${lap:raw} AND driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})
),
base AS (SELECT min(t0) AS t0 FROM own)
SELECT r.time - own.t0 + base.t0 AS time, r.car, r.type, own.slot, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.heading,
       r.speed_kmh, r.gear, r.throttle, r.brake
FROM $replay r JOIN $drivers d ON d.driver = r.car JOIN own ON own.driver_number = d.driver_number, base
WHERE r.time >= own.t0 AND r.time < own.t1
ORDER BY time

-- The track: driver A's fastest lap, as one line.
SELECT '{"type":"LineString","coordinates":['
       || string_agg('[' || round(longitude, 6) || ',' || round(latitude, 6) || ']', ',' ORDER BY time) || ']}' AS _geojson
FROM $duel WHERE slot = 'A' AND latitude IS NOT NULL

spec.description: Drivers A (blue) and B (orange) on the replay lap, B's clock moved so that both cross the line at the same moment: a race between the two laps, whatever the gap between them on track. Press ▶ on the time bar; the curves beside it follow it. On lap 1 each starts from their own grid slot.
spec.title: A against B, from the same start

spec.rawSql:
-- How far apart A and B are through the replay lap, both from their own start,
-- measured at the same place: each of B's positions is projected onto A's line
-- (the nearest of A's segments within 15 s of the same moment, so a parallel
-- stretch of track is never taken), and A's time there is interpolated along
-- that segment. B's time less A's: above zero A is ahead. The x axis is the
-- distance along A's line.
WITH own AS (
  SELECT driver_number, CASE driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot,
         date_start AS t0, date_end AS t1
  FROM $laps WHERE lap_number = ${lap:raw} AND driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})
),
p AS (
  SELECT own.slot, epoch(r.time - own.t0) AS t, r.latitude AS lat, r.longitude AS lon
  FROM $replay r JOIN $drivers d ON d.driver = r.car JOIN own ON own.driver_number = d.driver_number
  WHERE r.time >= own.t0 AND r.time < own.t1 AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL
),
k AS (SELECT cos(radians(avg(lat))) AS c FROM p),
xy AS (SELECT slot, t, lon * 111320 * k.c AS x, lat * 110574 AS y FROM p, k),
a AS (
  SELECT t, x, y, lead(t) OVER w AS t2, lead(x) OVER w AS x2, lead(y) OVER w AS y2
  FROM xy WHERE slot = 'A' WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY t)
),
seg AS (
  SELECT *, sqrt(pow(x2 - x, 2) + pow(y2 - y, 2)) AS len,
         coalesce(sum(sqrt(pow(x2 - x, 2) + pow(y2 - y, 2))) OVER (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS d0
  FROM a WHERE t2 IS NOT NULL
),
m AS (
  SELECT b.t AS tb, b.x AS px, b.y AS py, seg.*,
         CASE WHEN seg.len > 0 THEN greatest(0, least(1, ((b.x - seg.x) * (seg.x2 - seg.x) + (b.y - seg.y) * (seg.y2 - seg.y)) / (seg.len * seg.len))) ELSE 0 END AS u
  FROM xy b JOIN seg ON abs(seg.t - b.t) < 15
  WHERE b.slot = 'B'
),
hit AS (
  SELECT tb, arg_min(d0 + u * len, pow(px - x - u * (x2 - x), 2) + pow(py - y - u * (y2 - y), 2)) AS d,
             arg_min(t + u * (t2 - t), pow(px - x - u * (x2 - x), 2) + pow(py - y - u * (y2 - y), 2)) AS ta
  FROM m GROUP BY tb
)
-- Positions are a few metres off: a moving mean over seven samples (about two
-- seconds) takes out the tenth of jitter that leaves.
SELECT round(d) AS distance_m,
       round(avg(tb - ta) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING), 3) AS gap
FROM hit ORDER BY distance_m

spec.description: How far ahead one driver is of the other at each point of the replay lap, both from the same start: in blue where A is ahead, in orange where B is. Where the line climbs, A is gaining; where it falls, B is. Measured at the same place on track: each of B's positions against A's line.
spec.title: Gap through the lap

options.content: Drivers **A** (blue) and **B** (orange), picked above or from the results table on the first tab. The map races their two **replay laps** from the same start; the curves beside it and the gap below follow the same lap. Further down, the pace of every lap of the race, and their two fastest laps laid over each other.

spec.rawSql:
-- Safety car periods from race control: a DEPLOYED message starts one.
WITH sc AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE message NOT ILIKE '%VSC%' AND message NOT ILIKE '%VIRTUAL%') AS sc,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE message ILIKE '%VSC%' OR message ILIKE '%VIRTUAL%') AS vsc
  FROM $control WHERE kind = 'control' AND category = 'SafetyCar' AND message ILIKE '%DEPLOYED%'
),
w AS (SELECT avg(track_c) AS track_c, avg(air_c) AS air_c, max(rain) AS rain FROM $control WHERE kind = 'weather')
SELECT (SELECT driver FROM $drivers WHERE position = 1) AS "Winner",
       (SELECT printf('%d:%06.3f', floor(best_lap / 60)::INTEGER, best_lap % 60) || ' ' || driver
        FROM $drivers WHERE best_lap IS NOT NULL ORDER BY best_lap LIMIT 1) AS "Fastest lap",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $drivers WHERE result IN ('DNF', 'DNS', 'DSQ')) AS "Retired",
       (SELECT sum(stops) FROM $drivers) AS "Pit stops",
       sc.sc AS "Safety cars", sc.vsc AS "Virtual safety cars",
       round(w.track_c) AS "Track", round(w.air_c) AS "Air",
       CASE WHEN w.rain > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Rain"
FROM sc, w

spec.description: Fastest lap: the quickest lap anyone set in the race. Safety cars: how many times one came out, from race control. Track and air: mean temperatures over the race.
spec.title: The race

spec.rawSql: SELECT * FROM $replay ORDER BY time

-- The track: driver A's fastest lap, as one line.
SELECT '{"type":"LineString","coordinates":['
       || string_agg('[' || round(longitude, 6) || ',' || round(latitude, 6) || ']', ',' ORDER BY time) || ']}' AS _geojson
FROM $duel WHERE slot = 'A' AND latitude IS NOT NULL

spec.description: Every car through the picked lap, from the first one starting it to the last one finishing it, coloured by team. Press ▶ on the time bar to play it in real time; drag the bar to scrub. A car with no positions for that stretch is missing. Hover a car for its speed, gear, throttle and brake.
spec.title: Lap replay

spec.rawSql:
SELECT position AS "Pos", driver_number AS "No", driver AS "Driver", team AS "Team",
       result AS "Gap", points AS "Points", stops AS "Stops", best_lap AS "Best lap"
FROM $drivers ORDER BY position NULLS LAST, laps DESC, driver

spec.description: The classification. Click a driver to compare them as A (blue) or B (orange). No: car number. Gap: to the winner, or laps down. Best lap: their fastest of the race.
spec.title: Results

spec.rawSql:
SELECT d.driver, d.colour, d.team, l.lap_number AS lap, l.position,
       CASE l.driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' WHEN ${driver_b:raw} THEN 'B' ELSE '' END AS pick
FROM $laps l JOIN $drivers d USING (driver_number)
WHERE l.position IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.position NULLS LAST, d.laps DESC, d.driver, lap

-- Safety car periods: from a DEPLOYED message to the next ending of the same kind,
-- or to the end of the race.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date, lap_number AS lap, message ILIKE '%DEPLOYED%' AS starts,
         CASE WHEN message ILIKE '%VSC%' OR message ILIKE '%VIRTUAL%' THEN 'VSC' ELSE 'SC' END AS sc
  FROM $control WHERE kind = 'control' AND category = 'SafetyCar'
)
SELECT s.sc, s.lap AS from_lap,
       coalesce((SELECT min(e.lap) FROM m e WHERE e.sc = s.sc AND NOT e.starts AND e.date > s.date),
                (SELECT max(lap_number) FROM $laps)) AS to_lap
FROM m s WHERE s.starts ORDER BY s.date

spec.description: Each driver's position at the end of every lap, in team colours; a team's second driver is dashed, and drivers A and B are drawn thicker. Shaded: safety car (SC) and virtual safety car (VSC) periods. Hover a line to pick it out.
spec.title: Positions, lap by lap

spec.rawSql:
-- The race trace: how far behind the first car to finish each lap every driver
-- crossed the line. A lapped car falls a lap time further back each time.
WITH g AS (
  SELECT driver_number, lap_number, epoch(date_end - min(date_end) OVER (PARTITION BY lap_number)) AS gap
  FROM $laps WHERE date_end IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.driver, d.colour, d.team, g.lap_number AS lap, round(g.gap, 2) AS gap,
       CASE g.driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' WHEN ${driver_b:raw} THEN 'B' ELSE '' END AS pick
FROM g JOIN $drivers d USING (driver_number)
ORDER BY d.position NULLS LAST, d.laps DESC, d.driver, lap

-- Safety car periods: from a DEPLOYED message to the next ending of the same kind,
-- or to the end of the race.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date, lap_number AS lap, message ILIKE '%DEPLOYED%' AS starts,
         CASE WHEN message ILIKE '%VSC%' OR message ILIKE '%VIRTUAL%' THEN 'VSC' ELSE 'SC' END AS sc
  FROM $control WHERE kind = 'control' AND category = 'SafetyCar'
)
SELECT s.sc, s.lap AS from_lap,
       coalesce((SELECT min(e.lap) FROM m e WHERE e.sc = s.sc AND NOT e.starts AND e.date > s.date),
                (SELECT max(lap_number) FROM $laps)) AS to_lap
FROM m s WHERE s.starts ORDER BY s.date

spec.description: Seconds behind the leader at the end of every lap: the race trace. A pit stop is a drop of 20 seconds or so; under the safety car the field closes up. Cut at 90 s, past which cars are being lapped. Team colours; A and B thicker.
spec.title: Gap to the leader

spec.rawSql:
SELECT d.driver, l.stint, l.compound, min(l.lap_number) AS first_lap, max(l.lap_number) AS last_lap,
       min(l.tyre_age) AS age_start,
       CASE d.driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' WHEN ${driver_b:raw} THEN 'B' ELSE '' END AS pick,
       d.position, d.laps
FROM $laps l JOIN $drivers d USING (driver_number)
WHERE l.stint IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY d.position NULLS LAST, d.laps DESC, d.driver, first_lap

spec.description: Each driver's stints, from OpenF1's stints: the compound and the laps it ran. Hover a stint for how old the tyres were when it began. Drivers in finishing order; A and B in bold.
spec.title: Tyre strategy

spec.rawSql:
-- Lap times of A and B, without the laps that say little about pace: the first,
-- in and out laps, and anything slower than 107% of the driver's median (safety
-- car, incidents). The field's median of those same clean laps for reference.
WITH clean AS (
  SELECT *, median(lap_duration) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_number) AS med
  FROM $laps WHERE lap_number > 1 AND NOT pit_out AND NOT pit_in AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
),
ok AS (SELECT * FROM clean WHERE lap_duration < 1.07 * med),
field AS (SELECT lap_number, median(lap_duration) AS field FROM ok GROUP BY lap_number)
SELECT f.lap_number AS lap, round(f.field, 3) AS field,
       a.lap_duration AS a, a.compound AS a_tyre, a.tyre_age AS a_age,
       b.lap_duration AS b, b.compound AS b_tyre, b.tyre_age AS b_age
FROM field f
LEFT JOIN ok a ON a.lap_number = f.lap_number AND a.driver_number = ${driver_a:raw}
LEFT JOIN ok b ON b.lap_number = f.lap_number AND b.driver_number = ${driver_b:raw}
ORDER BY lap

SELECT CASE driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot, lap_number AS lap
FROM $laps WHERE pit_in AND driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw})

-- Safety car periods: from a DEPLOYED message to the next ending of the same kind,
-- or to the end of the race.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date, lap_number AS lap, message ILIKE '%DEPLOYED%' AS starts,
         CASE WHEN message ILIKE '%VSC%' OR message ILIKE '%VIRTUAL%' THEN 'VSC' ELSE 'SC' END AS sc
  FROM $control WHERE kind = 'control' AND category = 'SafetyCar'
)
SELECT s.sc, s.lap AS from_lap,
       coalesce((SELECT min(e.lap) FROM m e WHERE e.sc = s.sc AND NOT e.starts AND e.date > s.date),
                (SELECT max(lap_number) FROM $laps)) AS to_lap
FROM m s WHERE s.starts ORDER BY s.date

spec.description: Lap times of driver A (blue) and driver B (orange), against the median of the whole field. Left out: lap 1, in and out laps, and laps slower than 107% of the driver's median (safety car, incidents), which leave gaps. Dashed lines: their pit stops. Hover a lap for the tyres and their age.
spec.title: Race pace: A against B

spec.rawSql:
-- The lap split into 25 stretches of equal length. The time each driver took
-- over a stretch comes from the time into the lap at its two ends, interpolated
-- between samples; the stretch goes to whoever was quicker, drawn along A's line.
WITH len AS (SELECT min(m) AS len FROM (SELECT max(distance_m) AS m FROM $duel GROUP BY slot)),
pts AS (
  SELECT slot, distance_m AS d, t, lead(distance_m) OVER w AS d2, lead(t) OVER w AS t2
  FROM $duel WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY time)
),
bnd AS (SELECT k, k * len / 25 AS dk FROM range(1, 25) r(k), len),
tk AS (
  SELECT p.slot, b.k, p.t + (p.t2 - p.t) * (b.dk - p.d) / (p.d2 - p.d) AS tk
  FROM bnd b JOIN pts p ON b.dk >= p.d AND b.dk < p.d2
  UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT slot, 0, 0 FROM $duel
  UNION ALL SELECT slot, 25, any_value(lap_s) FROM $duel GROUP BY slot
),
sec AS (SELECT slot, k, lead(tk) OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY k) - tk AS dt FROM tk),
cmp AS (
  SELECT a.k, a.dt AS dt_a, b.dt AS dt_b, CASE WHEN a.dt <= b.dt THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS faster
  FROM sec a JOIN sec b ON b.k = a.k AND b.slot = 'B' WHERE a.slot = 'A' AND a.dt IS NOT NULL
),
names AS (
  SELECT max(driver) FILTER (WHERE driver_number = ${driver_a:raw}) AS a,
         max(driver) FILTER (WHERE driver_number = ${driver_b:raw}) AS b
  FROM $drivers
),
path AS (
  SELECT least(24, floor(distance_m / len * 25))::INTEGER AS k, time, latitude, longitude
  FROM $duel, len WHERE slot = 'A' AND latitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- Each stretch's line runs on to the first point of the next, so they join up.
joined AS (
  SELECT k, time, latitude, longitude FROM path
  UNION ALL
  SELECT k - 1, time, latitude, longitude FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY time) AS i FROM path) WHERE i = 1 AND k > 0
)
SELECT '{"type":"LineString","coordinates":['
         || string_agg('[' || round(longitude, 6) || ',' || round(latitude, 6) || ']', ',' ORDER BY time) || ']}' AS _geojson,
       c.k + 1 AS stretch, c.faster,
       CASE c.faster WHEN 'A' THEN names.a ELSE names.b END AS quicker,
       round(abs(c.dt_a - c.dt_b), 3) AS by_s
FROM joined j JOIN cmp c USING (k), names
GROUP BY c.k, c.faster, names.a, names.b, c.dt_a, c.dt_b
ORDER BY stretch

spec.description: The fastest laps of driver A and driver B, split into 25 stretches of equal length, each coloured by who was quicker over it: blue A, orange B. Hover a stretch for by how much. Drawn along A's line.
spec.title: Who is quicker where

spec.description: OpenF1 has every session from 2023 on.
spec.label: Season
spec.name: year

spec.description: Grands prix and sprints that finished at least three hours ago.
spec.label: Race
spec.name: session

spec.sql:
-- The newest first, so a new season opens on its latest race.
SELECT session_key::BIGINT::VARCHAR AS value,
       country_name || ' · ' || location || ' · ' || session_name || ' · ' || strftime(date_start, '%-d %b') AS text
FROM $sessions ORDER BY date_start DESC

-- The circuit's centre and the turn and scale from OpenF1's x/y, for the server SQL.
SELECT concat_ws(',', lat0, lon0, a, b, e0, n0) AS value FROM $sessions WHERE session_key = ${session:raw}
SELECT coalesce(round(lat0, 5), 0)::VARCHAR AS value FROM $sessions WHERE session_key = ${session:raw}
SELECT coalesce(round(lon0, 5), 0)::VARCHAR AS value FROM $sessions WHERE session_key = ${session:raw}

query.rawSql:
-- Server side, on every change of race: one row per driver, with the result,
-- the best lap and the pit stops. OpenF1's drivers, session_result, laps and
-- pit, kept a month by the gateway. A gap is seconds to the winner, or laps
-- down ("+1 LAP"), so it stays text.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/drivers?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', name_acronym: 'VARCHAR', full_name: 'VARCHAR',
               team_name: 'VARCHAR', team_colour: 'VARCHAR'})
),
r AS (
  SELECT * FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/session_result?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', position: 'INTEGER', number_of_laps: 'INTEGER', points: 'DOUBLE',
               dnf: 'BOOLEAN', dns: 'BOOLEAN', dsq: 'BOOLEAN', duration: 'VARCHAR', gap_to_leader: 'VARCHAR'})
),
l AS (
  SELECT driver_number, min(lap_duration) AS best_lap, arg_min(lap_number, lap_duration) AS best_lap_number,
         max(st_speed) AS top_speed
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/laps?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', lap_number: 'INTEGER', lap_duration: 'DOUBLE', st_speed: 'INTEGER'})
  GROUP BY ALL
),
p AS (
  SELECT driver_number, count(*) AS stops, min(lane_duration) AS best_pit_lane
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/pit?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', lap_number: 'INTEGER', lane_duration: 'DOUBLE'})
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT d.driver_number, d.name_acronym AS driver, d.full_name, d.team_name AS team,
       '#' || coalesce(d.team_colour, '909090') AS colour,
       r.position,
       CASE WHEN r.dsq THEN 'DSQ' WHEN r.dns THEN 'DNS' WHEN r.dnf THEN 'DNF'
            WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 'Winner'
            WHEN try_cast(r.gap_to_leader AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || printf('%.3f', r.gap_to_leader::DOUBLE) || ' s'
            ELSE r.gap_to_leader END AS result,
       r.number_of_laps AS laps, coalesce(r.points, 0) AS points,
       try_cast(r.duration AS DOUBLE) AS race_time_s,
       l.best_lap, l.best_lap_number, l.top_speed,
       coalesce(p.stops, 0) AS stops, p.best_pit_lane
FROM d LEFT JOIN r USING (driver_number) LEFT JOIN l USING (driver_number) LEFT JOIN p USING (driver_number)
ORDER BY r.position NULLS LAST, r.number_of_laps DESC, d.driver_number

-- Server side, on every change of race: one row per driver and lap, about a
-- thousand, with its tyre (from the stints), its position when the lap ended
-- (the last position change before then) and whether the driver pitted at its
-- end. OpenF1's laps, stints, position and pit, kept a month by the gateway.
WITH l AS (
  SELECT *, coalesce(lead(date_start) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_number ORDER BY lap_number),
                     date_start + to_microseconds(CAST(lap_duration * 1e6 AS BIGINT))) AS date_end
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/laps?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', lap_number: 'INTEGER', date_start: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', lap_duration: 'DOUBLE',
               duration_sector_1: 'DOUBLE', duration_sector_2: 'DOUBLE', duration_sector_3: 'DOUBLE',
               is_pit_out_lap: 'BOOLEAN', st_speed: 'INTEGER'})
),
s AS (
  SELECT * FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/stints?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', stint_number: 'INTEGER', lap_start: 'INTEGER', lap_end: 'INTEGER',
               compound: 'VARCHAR', tyre_age_at_start: 'INTEGER'})
),
p AS (
  SELECT * FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/position?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', position: 'INTEGER'})
),
pit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driver_number, lap_number
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/pit?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', lap_number: 'INTEGER'})
)
SELECT l.driver_number, l.lap_number, l.date_start, l.date_end, l.lap_duration,
       l.duration_sector_1 AS sector_1, l.duration_sector_2 AS sector_2, l.duration_sector_3 AS sector_3,
       coalesce(l.is_pit_out_lap, false) AS pit_out, pit.lap_number IS NOT NULL AS pit_in, l.st_speed AS trap_speed,
       s.stint_number AS stint, coalesce(s.compound, 'UNKNOWN') AS compound,
       s.tyre_age_at_start + l.lap_number - s.lap_start AS tyre_age,
       p.position
FROM l
LEFT JOIN s ON s.driver_number = l.driver_number AND l.lap_number BETWEEN s.lap_start AND s.lap_end
LEFT JOIN pit ON pit.driver_number = l.driver_number AND pit.lap_number = l.lap_number
ASOF LEFT JOIN p ON p.driver_number = l.driver_number AND p.date <= l.date_end
ORDER BY l.driver_number, l.lap_number

-- Server side, on every change of race: race control's flags, safety cars and
-- penalties, and the weather once a minute. OpenF1's race_control and weather,
-- kept a month by the gateway.
WITH rc AS (
  SELECT date, lap_number, category, flag, scope, sector, driver_number, message
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/race_control?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', lap_number: 'INTEGER', category: 'VARCHAR', flag: 'VARCHAR', scope: 'VARCHAR',
               sector: 'INTEGER', driver_number: 'INTEGER', message: 'VARCHAR'})
),
w AS (
  SELECT date, air_temperature, track_temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind_speed
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/weather?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', air_temperature: 'DOUBLE', track_temperature: 'DOUBLE', humidity: 'DOUBLE',
               rainfall: 'DOUBLE', wind_speed: 'DOUBLE'})
)
SELECT 'control' AS kind, date, lap_number, category, flag, scope, sector, driver_number, message,
       NULL::DOUBLE AS air_c, NULL::DOUBLE AS track_c, NULL::DOUBLE AS humidity, NULL::DOUBLE AS rain, NULL::DOUBLE AS wind_ms
FROM rc
UNION ALL
SELECT 'weather', date, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       air_temperature, track_temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind_speed
FROM w
ORDER BY date

-- The winner first, so a new race opens on the winner against second place.
SELECT driver_number::BIGINT::VARCHAR AS value, driver || ' · ' || coalesce('P' || position::INTEGER, coalesce(result, '')) || ' · ' || team AS text
FROM $drivers ORDER BY position NULLS LAST, laps DESC, driver

-- Second place first, so a new race opens on the winner against second place.
SELECT driver_number::BIGINT::VARCHAR AS value, driver || ' · ' || coalesce('P' || position::INTEGER, coalesce(result, '')) || ' · ' || team AS text
FROM $drivers ORDER BY position = 2 DESC, position NULLS LAST, laps DESC, driver

query.rawSql:
-- Server side, on every change of race or lap: every car through the picked
-- lap, about four positions a second, with its speed, gear, throttle, brake
-- and DRS at that moment. The window runs from the first car starting the lap
-- to the last one finishing it (four minutes at most, for a lap behind the
-- safety car), and only that window is asked of OpenF1's location and
-- car_data, kept a month by the gateway.
SET VARIABLE w = (
  SELECT {'t0': min(date_start),
          't1': least(min(date_start) + INTERVAL 4 MINUTE,
                      coalesce(max(date_start + to_microseconds(CAST(lap_duration * 1e6 AS BIGINT))),
                               min(date_start) + INTERVAL 2 MINUTE))}
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/laps?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {lap_number: 'INTEGER', date_start: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', lap_duration: 'DOUBLE'})
  WHERE lap_number = ${lap:raw}
);
SET VARIABLE q = 'session_key=${session:raw}&date>='
  || strftime(timezone('UTC', date_trunc('second', getvariable('w').t0)), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
  || '&date<' || strftime(timezone('UTC', date_trunc('second', getvariable('w').t1) + INTERVAL 1 SECOND), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S');
-- The circuit's place on the map comes from the sessions dataset, through the geo variable.
WITH g AS (
  SELECT try_cast(p[1] AS DOUBLE) AS lat0, try_cast(p[2] AS DOUBLE) AS lon0, try_cast(p[3] AS DOUBLE) AS a,
         try_cast(p[4] AS DOUBLE) AS b, try_cast(p[5] AS DOUBLE) AS e0, try_cast(p[6] AS DOUBLE) AS n0
  FROM (SELECT string_split('${geo:raw}', ',') AS p)
),
d AS (
  SELECT driver_number, name_acronym AS car, team_name AS team
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/drivers?session_key=${session:raw}',
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', name_acronym: 'VARCHAR', team_name: 'VARCHAR'})
),
loc AS (
  SELECT driver_number, date AS time, g.a * x - g.b * y + g.e0 AS e, g.b * x + g.a * y + g.n0 AS n, g.lat0, g.lon0
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/location?' || getvariable('q'),
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', x: 'DOUBLE', y: 'DOUBLE'}), g
),
car AS (
  SELECT driver_number, date AS time, speed, n_gear, throttle, brake, drs
  FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/car_data?' || getvariable('q'),
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', speed: 'INTEGER', n_gear: 'INTEGER',
               throttle: 'INTEGER', brake: 'INTEGER', drs: 'INTEGER'})
),
m AS (
  SELECT *, e - lag(e) OVER w AS de, n - lag(n) OVER w AS dn
  FROM loc WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY driver_number ORDER BY time)
)
SELECT m.time, d.car, 'car' AS type, d.team,
       m.lat0 + m.n / 110574 AS latitude,
       m.lon0 + m.e / (111320 * cos(radians(m.lat0))) AS longitude,
       CASE WHEN de * de + dn * dn > 1 THEN round((degrees(atan2(de, dn)) + 360) % 360) END AS heading,
       car.speed AS speed_kmh, car.n_gear AS gear, car.throttle, car.brake,
       car.drs >= 10 AS drs_open
FROM m JOIN d USING (driver_number)
ASOF LEFT JOIN car ON car.driver_number = m.driver_number AND car.time <= m.time
ORDER BY m.time, d.car

spec.label: The fastest laps of drivers A and B
spec.name: duel

query.rawSql:
-- Server side, on every change of race or drivers: the fastest lap of each of
-- the two picked drivers, sample by sample, with the distance into the lap
-- (speed integrated over time, scaled so both laps measure the same), the
-- time into the lap, and where the car was. Only those two laps are asked of
-- OpenF1's car_data and location, kept a month by the gateway.
SET VARIABLE w = (
  SELECT list({'slot': slot, 'driver': driver_number, 'lap': lap_number, 't0': date_start,
               't1': date_start + to_microseconds(CAST(lap_duration * 1e6 AS BIGINT))} ORDER BY slot)
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE driver_number WHEN ${driver_a:raw} THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS slot,
           driver_number, arg_min(lap_number, lap_duration) AS lap_number,
           arg_min(date_start, lap_duration) AS date_start, min(lap_duration) AS lap_duration
    FROM read_json('http://feeds/openf1/v1/laps?session_key=${session:raw}',
      columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', lap_number: 'INTEGER', date_start: 'TIMESTAMPTZ',
                 lap_duration: 'DOUBLE', is_pit_out_lap: 'BOOLEAN'})
    WHERE driver_number IN (${driver_a:raw}, ${driver_b:raw}) AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT coalesce(is_pit_out_lap, false) AND date_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY driver_number
  )
);
SET VARIABLE urls = (
  SELECT list('session_key=${session:raw}&driver_number=' || x.driver
              || '&date>=' || strftime(timezone('UTC', date_trunc('second', x.t0)), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
              || '&date<' || strftime(timezone('UTC', date_trunc('second', x.t1) + INTERVAL 2 SECOND), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'))
  FROM (SELECT unnest(getvariable('w')) AS x)
);
WITH win AS (SELECT unnest(getvariable('w'), recursive := true)),
g AS (
  SELECT try_cast(p[1] AS DOUBLE) AS lat0, try_cast(p[2] AS DOUBLE) AS lon0, try_cast(p[3] AS DOUBLE) AS a,
         try_cast(p[4] AS DOUBLE) AS b, try_cast(p[5] AS DOUBLE) AS e0, try_cast(p[6] AS DOUBLE) AS n0
  FROM (SELECT string_split('${geo:raw}', ',') AS p)
),
car AS (
  SELECT win.slot, win.lap, c.date AS time, epoch(c.date - win.t0) AS t, c.speed, c.throttle, c.brake, c.n_gear, c.drs,
         epoch(win.t1 - win.t0) AS lap_s
  FROM read_json(list_transform(getvariable('urls'), u -> 'http://feeds/openf1/v1/car_data?' || u),
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', speed: 'INTEGER', throttle: 'INTEGER', brake: 'INTEGER',
               n_gear: 'INTEGER', drs: 'INTEGER'}) c
  JOIN win ON win.driver = c.driver_number AND c.date BETWEEN win.t0 AND win.t1
),
dist AS (
  SELECT *, sum(speed / 3.6 * dt) OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY time) AS raw_m
  FROM (SELECT *, coalesce(t - lag(t) OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY time), t) AS dt FROM car)
),
scaled AS (
  SELECT *, raw_m * avg(max_m) OVER () / max_m AS distance_m
  FROM (SELECT *, max(raw_m) OVER (PARTITION BY slot) AS max_m FROM dist)
),
loc AS (
  SELECT win.slot, l.date AS time, g.lat0 + (g.b * x + g.a * y + g.n0) / 110574 AS latitude,
         g.lon0 + (g.a * x - g.b * y + g.e0) / (111320 * cos(radians(g.lat0))) AS longitude
  FROM read_json(list_transform(getvariable('urls'), u -> 'http://feeds/openf1/v1/location?' || u),
    columns = {driver_number: 'INTEGER', date: 'TIMESTAMPTZ', x: 'DOUBLE', y: 'DOUBLE'}) l
  JOIN win ON win.driver = l.driver_number AND l.date BETWEEN win.t0 AND win.t1, g
)
SELECT s.slot, s.lap, s.time, round(s.t, 3) AS t, round(s.distance_m, 1) AS distance_m, s.lap_s,
       s.speed AS speed_kmh, s.throttle, CASE WHEN s.brake > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS brake,
       s.n_gear AS gear, s.drs >= 10 AS drs_open, loc.latitude, loc.longitude
FROM scaled s ASOF LEFT JOIN loc ON loc.slot = s.slot AND loc.time <= s.time
ORDER BY s.slot, s.time
